title: 0207 - data-free frontier constants now premise-free + A1 terminal face QUANTIFIED in-tree. TransNums gains 3 frontier log pins (log 3e10 < 25, log log 3e10 < 4, 24 < log 3e10, all exact-rational norm_num, margins x1.043..x1.136); A1Growth.pin_explicit_3e10's two CITED numerics retired (pin_explicit_3e10_free, pin_explicit_wire_3e10_free); face quantification: any absolute K at the frontier lies in [2.490066528, 7) S-side, measured wire 5.56 < data-free 17; face_unbounded proves the gap is G-constantness, not a numeric; single remaining cited input = Trudgian A1G-5. No RH claim
body: 0207 attacks the hA1 main event on the side of the strongest currently provable statements and quantifies the terminal face in-tree. (1) TransNums new premise-free frontier pins: log (30000000000) < 25 - proven via 3e10 < finsum(25, 24) (exact: 33838768480593780243940600998001/992717442773183102976, margin x1.136) + expFinsum_le_exp; log (log 3e10) < 4 - via log 3e10 < 25 < exp 4 with finsum(4, 7) = 16319/315 ~ 51.81; and the LOWER bracket 24 < log (3e10) - via exp 24 < 3e10, i.e. finsum(24, 27) + geometric tail (exp_le_finsum_plus_geometric, a/(N+2) = 24/29) = 2.875467e10 < 3e10 (margin x1.043, tightest bracket in the module so far). All closed by norm_num on exact rationals. (2) A1Growth: pin_explicit_3e10_free (G_explicit 3e10 < 7) and pin_explicit_wire_3e10_free ((G + 1)(17/8) < 17) restate the 0206 'stone B' pins with the two CITED numerics (log 3e10 < 25, log log 3e10 < 4) replaced by the in-tree 0207 theorems - the data-free wire constants K < 8 and |S1 - R| < 17 at the 3e10 frontier are now machine-verified end to end; the single remaining CITED input of the whole data-free lane is the Trudgian growth bound itself (A1G-5, Math. Comp. 2012 - a literature theorem, the named frontier, not a numeric). (3) Face quantification (A1Growth section 7, all no-premise pure-rational pins): sPinMeasured0207 = 2490066528/1e9 and dnPinMeasured0207 = 2615066528/1e9 (data records 0201/0202, identical numerics to the W2SAtZeros pins); pin_face_S_3e10: 2.490066528 < 7; pin_face_S_interval_3e10: 2.490066528 < G_explicit (3e10) ITSELF (using the new lower bracket 24 < log 3e10 + positivity of the log-log term) - hence any absolute K dominating |S| on the measured 3e10 domain must lie in [2.490066528, 7), both ends now machine-checked; pin_face_wire_3e10: 2.615066528 . (17/8) < 17 (measured wire cost ~5.56 vs data-free < 17, margin ~3x). (4) face_unbounded (hE : exp 1 < 4 as the only classical premise, per module convention): for every K there exists T with K < G_explicit T (two-case proof: K < 2.45 uses T = 4; otherwise T = exp U with U = (1000/111)(K - 2.45) + 4). The face gap is therefore precisely the CONSTANTNESS of G: the absolute clause hA1 (|S(γ)| ≤ C / |DN| ≤ K data-free at the zeros) is the growth wire at a constant growth function, and the data-free tree proves the available G outruns every K while |S| strictly rises at every measured ladder step (W2SAtZeros 0204-0206, in-tree) - the interval's lower end can only grow with the data. F1/F2 literature status unchanged: no theorem in the literature gives an absolute C (best unconditional bounds are growth-form; even under RH the CCM (1/4) log/loglog bound GROWS; Bondarenko-Seip conditional Omega grows). (5) Pinned-API lessons: norm_num cannot prove 0 < exp a (use exp_pos); the calc parser in this toolchain requires continuation lines (`_ <`, `_ =`) to be indented DEEPER than the calc keyword line - same-indent continuations silently terminate the calc block and cascade into 'unknown identifier' parse errors; multi-line `:= by` tactic blocks inside calc steps break - single-line them (`:= by dsimp [U]; ring_nf; linarith`); not_lt.mp (there is no le_of_not_lt); rw [log_exp] rewrites the innermost log(exp .) under outer logs in one pass; exp_le_finsum_plus_geometric's surface form is (N+1)/(N+2)-shaped - state bracket goals in that exact surface form. Session incident: a malformed `sed -i` clobbered TransNums mid-session - restored from git (committed at 0206), reinforcing the python-surgery rule: verify before+after any in-place rewrite. Builds: TransNums 8706 green; A1Growth 8713 green; full package build green (log tmp/build_0207.log). No RH claim: everything is the data-free lane's strongest-provable boundary + the measured data flank; hA1 (the absolute clause) remains NAMED and NOT CLOSED - the single open theorem of the A1 assembly.
